Our client is a leading aerospace manufacturer specializing in precision mechanical and electro-mechanical assemblies for both commercial and defense applications. The Operations Manager will oversee all aspects of machining operations, including planning, scheduling, manpower allocation, and production efficiency across multiple machining centers.   • Proven ability to lead teams, manage production priorities, and meet operational goals.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Planning, Quality, Engineering, and Supply Chain.

title: Civil Engineer - Environmental Services
description:
CIVIL ENGINEER – ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES
 
Location: Greenville, SC
Job type: Permanent/Full-time
 
Our global EPC Firm client is hiring a Civil Engineer – Environmental Services for a full-time/permanent opportunity in Greenville, SC. 
 
The Civil Engineer will support a wide variety of civil and environmental engineering designs for new projects, alterations, and redevelopments on a variety of projects, including high-voltage transmission line routing and siting, natural gas, renewable projects, commercial development, power generation, water treatment facilities, emergency response, and contribute to implementing department strategy, vision, and culture.

title: ELECTRICAL ENGINEER – SUBSTATION
description:
ELECTRICAL ENGINEER – SUBSTATION

Location: Chesterfield, MO
Job type: Permanent/Full-time

Our global EPC Firm client is hiring an Electrical Engineer – Substation for a full-time/permanent opportunity in their Chesterfield, MO.

The Electrical Engineer – Substation is responsible for substation engineering and consulting services for clients across the US and internationally. Main responsibilities include creating electrical protection & control and/or physical layout design deliverables. Projects range in size, complexity, and voltage class from small distribution facility upgrades to large transmission projects. This position can influence the future of the resiliency, reliability, and economic operation of the electric grid.
  • Principal responsibilities include the design of high voltage (13kV-500kV) electrical substations. Areas of design and responsibilities include leading and executing the following:
  • Preparation of proposals and scope development, including conceptual designs and execution plans.
  • Prepare engineering cost and labor estimates and schedules.
  • Physical substation design, including yard layouts, plans, sections, and details, grounding, lightning protection, control building arrangements, interior and exterior raceways, auxiliary AC/DC power systems, and associated bills of material.
  • Protection and control design, including panel arrangements, one lines/single lines, three lines, AC schematics, DC elementaries, equipment wiring, and relay panel wiring.
  • Preparing calculations and reports for engineering studies (grounding, lightning protection, AC/DC load studies, etc.)
  • Preparing equipment specifications for procurement and/or factory acceptance testing.
  • Coordinating design activities with other departments (Civil/Structural, Networks, Transmission Line, etc.)
  • Providing guidance and mentoring to less experienced team members.
  • Regularly meeting with and corresponding with clients or outside personnel.
  • Performing quality reviews for other engineers and designers.
  • Providing short-term field support during construction.
  • Supporting business development and marketing initiatives.
  • Other areas of involvement may include relay settings, 3D/intelligent design, or industry/professional technical committee involvement.

REQUIREMENTS
  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related degree from an ABET-accredited program and 3 years of electrical engineering experience, consulting preferred.
    • OR a Bachelor's Degree in Electrical or related Engineering Technology from an ABET-accredited program and successful completion of Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam and 3 years of electrical engineering experience, consulting preferred.
    • OR a Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering and 2 years of electrical engineering experience, consulting preferred.

This is an exciting and fulfilling opportunity with Zachry Group's Projects Technology Systems team. We are looking for a motivated individual eager to contribute and learn. The Projects Technology Delivery Manager is the primary Enterprise Technology contact for Engineering, Procurement, Construction (EPC) projects. The position is responsible for intake of project technology related requests to be solutioned and delivered by Zachry Enterprise Technology. Technology requests may be wide-ranging including but not limited to site connectivity setup, mobile device acquisition, application deployment, system integration, data orchestration, and dashboard development. The position will serve as a high-level role supporting technology needs across multiple projects and locations.

  • Oversee project technology requests from inception to completion ensuring all work products are delivered
  • Prepare and communicate project technology plans and maintain transparency of delivery status throughout the project life cycle.
  • Ensure project technology scope and budget is defined, controlled and managed through changes
  • Coordinate activities to obtain appropriate approvals and signoffs for unplanned project work requests
  • Shephard relationships with operational and technical teams through collaboration and communication with internal and external project stakeholders.

  • Define, support, and recommend standards and work practices to enable and govern efficient project technology services collaboration, solution development, and delivery.

  • Other duties, projects, and assignments as assigned.

  • A minimum of five (5) years' experience in multi-discipline projects within the EPC industry in business analysis, systems administration, project management or similar roles.
